lens: device Lab task completion, display scope, accessibility and recovery
persona: Internal iOS product tester using synthetic relationship data

resolved_findings.finding: The temporary-trial banner overlapped workspace navigation.
resolved_findings.correction: Reserve a separate layout row outside page NavigationStacks.
resolved_findings.proof: testTemporaryAppDisplayRestoresAndPresetDoesNotAutoApply switches People and Today while the trial is active.

resolved_findings.finding: Preview navigation did not provide the required explicit target geometry.
resolved_findings.correction: Use a separate preview header with 44-point controls and fixed-size symbols; preserve Dynamic Type for text.
resolved_findings.proof: testSystemAX5PreviewKeepsCloseAndDisplayControlsReachable checks target height, status-area position and actual system accessibility floor.

resolved_findings.finding: Saving a preset could be confused with applying it or changing personal preferences.
resolved_findings.correction: Use separate save, load, temporary apply and explicit personal-preference actions.
resolved_findings.proof: The native relaunch journey preserves the preset and restores prior effective display values.

meaning.data: synthetic person identities, proposals, evidence and states
meaning.execution_authority: none from a preview or saved preset

limits: No physical-device or comprehensive VoiceOver certification.
Contrast is a rendering preview, not a system contrast override.
Bounds do not measure every UIKit hit region or text baseline.
Guided performance diagnostics, composite reset, remaining experiment coverage, observation controls and Web review remain in the full plan.
